checks.check: A1 B is self-adjoint and odd under the normal grading G
A2 boundary values of collar solutions converge to the positive spectral projector of B for every interior condition
A3 the convergence rate is twice the smallest eigenvalue of |B| (the seed scale of the original)
A4 the limit obeys the Lagrange relation G P G = 1 - P
B1 Gaussian interior state, finite collar: the two-point function is the projector onto the transported space
B2 that boundary state is pure for every collar length (C^2 = C)
B3 long collar: also a non-Gaussian interior state ends in the Fock state of the positive spectral projector
C1 with f = -log|x| the primitive action is exactly minus the logarithm of det(D_rel)/det(D_ref), phase included
C2 for that profile the seed scale chi drops out of the action
C3 the phase term (i pi/2) Delta eta alone already equals the phase of the relative fermion determinant
C4 a Gaussian profile does not give the determinant (the modulus part depends on the declared profile)
D1 the Fock vacuum of a polarised block transforms with the determinant: it spans the determinant line of the block
